styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a brown, mottled dirt ground with a few small brick and mortar lumps. The soil has speckle and grain in about 4-5 steps. Measured facts back this up: 5 visible tones per tile, above the grass reference (3) and below paving (7); 0% near-flat coverage; 0% neutral dark edge pixels. The surface has no flat fills and reads as a ground texture, not a sticker. It is a little sparser and less varied than the references: the lumps are few and small, and the red brick dust patch is weak. Overall it is comparable to the grass reference, so I accept it.
